en: Hiya!😘 Just got off work!
Sorry to keep you waiting~
Being a shop owner is just soooo busy. Would totes make me dizzy😵‍💫
Well
WOULD, if I wasn't such a natural at it~
Hopefully I'm not disturbing your work hours!
Speaking of...
What do you do for work?
A chef
I'm the owner and chef at our town's fanciest restaurant, I make good money and it makes me an excellent cook.
I'd love to make you something.
Wow, wow, wow!
I looove that!
And I love that place! 🥰🥰
Two business owners?! We could like totally be the faces of this town!
The food in your picture DOES look yummy.
Speaking of which, why can't I see your face?
Not flattering
All my pictures are of me at the club so they're not exactly flattering
But I love to socialize in my free time.
I need to go out and take better pictures, wanna come with?
That's okay. I'll see you on our dream date!💕
Cus that's what that plan sounds like to me!!
It's time to partay!!!🥳🥳
Got any fave tunes to dance to?
Anything!
I love anything that makes me feel it in my bones.
I need to be able to dance to the beat!
OMG!!💕💕
Me too!
We should dance together!💃💃💃
Let's decide on where to go! TONITE!
Nothing in particular
I love what everyone else loves, I'm not particular about what I listen to...
Fun is important to me so I must know❗❗
I think knowing what you like is soooo important!!!
but 🤚🤚!!
You can always get a strong opinion as you explore
So let's explore 🗺🗺 tonite!
Classical
I love slow classical... Melodic soft music is the best...
Oh!
Welll, I hope you're open to learning to 💕LOVE💕 something new!
Let's show you what you're missing tonite!🌟
Undecided
I haven't been able to decide which my selfies to put up but you're right, I should.
I will do that soon
Now is always better than soon or later!
You should totally get to it! ⏰⏰⏰
After that tell me, what do you do for fun?!
Fun is important to me so I must know❗❗
Full Adventures
I love going on adventures, I'm a thrill seeker, especially if I can do it in a group!
Wow!!
That's totes sooo cool 😎😎.
How about one tonite?
arty time!🥂
Go out Sometimes
I go out once in a while, usually wherever my friends decide
I couldn't do it every day though, I don't have the energy...
Oh!
You might have missed it but I love going out every night!
You’re not the one for me!🥀
Sea ya~!
Homebody
My social battery is kind of shit tbh, so I'm more of a homebody.
I prefer to do things that keep me inside, away from people... Maybe we could do that together?
Oh
That sounds very... chill🧊.
You might have missed it but I don't really do... that.
You’re not the one for me! 🥀🥀
Sea Ya!
I’m shy
I don't want strangers to look at me...
I'm shy.
What if they think I'm ugly...?
Confidence is key!! 💪
No one can decide you're ugly except you!
How often do you go out? With you being shy...
Skiing
I actually like skiing!
It can get intense but being out in the snow is so fun even when it gets risky.
Woah!!
Maybe you are shy but you sound so so cool!
You should tell me more about it!
Tonite!!
Here and there
I go out here and there
To house parties or small gatherings
Definitely nothing more intense than that
That's kinda cool...
Not really my style tho
kinda like you!
You’re not the one for me.🥀
Sea ya!
Not much...
Not much, I prefer to do as little as possible to not get my heart stressing...
A chef that can't handle the heat🔥 of the kitchen?
That's so disappointing😒👎
You’re not the one for me.🥀
Sea ya!
Grocery store
I work at a grocery store, it's just to carry me until I can start my forever career soon.
I've been there!🤝
It can totally feel hard to start but once you do, you better grind
ill you're at the top!
Hopefully you start soon...
What's your dream career?
Business owner
I love working, I would like something that challenges me daily so that I feel like I always have something to overcome!
I'd love to start my own business
Wow!
Respect that 💯%
You will totally get there, trust!
What do you do for fun when you're not preparing to be a big shot? 😎
Social events
I like to go to social events, both for people looking to make connections and ones for fun!
Hey hey, you're totally like me! Once you're a boss, you're going far!
Let's meet up!
Tonite!!!
Walks around town
I enjoy walking the town
Spending time just taking things in and decompressing
It is my favorite past time for sure
We seem to have a similar drive but don't click anywhere else😩😭
You’re not the one for me! Sea ya!
Relax at home
I stay home and relax
I think any time I'm not working, I take the opportunity to rest...
You'll make a good business owner but I need someone who is also the life of the party!🎉
You aren't the one for me! 🥀🥀
Sea ya!
Anything
Work is work, doesn't really matter if I'm the boss or the employee as long as I get paid
I guess,,,
Being so apathetic to your role doesn't seem like a career oriented move...🫤❓
Well, what you do for fun?
Maybe your energy is directed elsewhere!
Sports
I love intense sports, things outside work must be wild and get my blood running!
You seem fun outside of work, but I'd like someone that can totally ♊match♊ me in all aspects
This isn't going to work! You’re not the one for me!🥀
Sea ya!
Little of everything
A little big of everything I suppose... running... swimming
You don't know yourself and I want someone like that to get to know me??
I don’t even think you can.
You are not the one for me!🥀
Sea ya!
Reading
I mostly read and stay home, I prefer quiet spaces
LOVE someone with knowledge🤓!!!
But we don't seem to match anywhere🙁🙁 !
You are not the one for me🥀, sea ya!
Not sure...
I don't know, hopefully something where I don't have to speak to people often...
I would rather get to hide in the back and not be there for long
You seem to not have a lot of confidence...
What are your hobbies?
You must do something for fun!
Thrill seeking
I enjoy amusement parks, I specifically travel to places with wild coasters!
That sounds so fun!
Not exactly my idea of a good time however, soz!
You're not the one for me.🥀 Sea Ya!
Running
I like going on runs, it gets the blood running without too much other types of intensity
We both love to feel our blood pumping but not even in the same way.
We don't match at all. 🥀🥀
You're not the one for me! Sea Ya!
I do but...
I don't like going out...
My hobbies have big communities online and I'm still too scared to participate  in that honestly
You clearly need a confidence boost...
However, I'd prefer someone already stable.
You are not the one for me!🥀 Sea Ya!
Unemployed
I'm unemployed...
Not really looking for a job at the moment... It'll come when it comes.
Yikes! 😬
That's not great mentality!
What do you do in your free time? 🤔
I'm sure you have a lot of it!
Party
I love to party!
I love being the center of attention and the life of the room
Well, we have that in common!
I love a good party! What's your favorite kind of party scene?
Loud Party
A loud party! Either music or chatting.
I enjoy when everyone can sing to the music and dance together!
Well, you need to get your motivation to thrive in the work place, but at least we could have a blast together!
Let's meet tonite!
Chatty Party
Something for chatting, like a dinner party where everyone can listen to me speak.
Preferably it ends early too.
We both enjoy to socialize our vibes are too different.
You're not the one for me!🥀
Sea ya!
Dj Booth
I enjoy the party from the DJ booth so I don't have to dance! Everyone can listen to my tunes instead
The 🎧DJ🎶 carries the party but I need someone who can take me to the dance floor! What’s a party without some?!
You're not the one for me🥀, sea ya!
Relaxing vibes
I like going out once in a while, no parties or crowded spaces regularly thoug
I love going out! We don't have the same taste though, what a shame...
Well, what kind of music do you play at your party?
Something with rhythm
Something fun and with a good vibe but never loud enough that we can't sit and chat
That sounds like a vibe but not like mine🫤🫤
It's too bad. You're not the one for me!🥀 Sea ya!
Indie artists
I like niche music most people don't know, I don’t let others choose, honestly.
I love showing everyone good new music they've never heard of, nothing mainstream
That's interesting but if I can't put in a request, it doesn't sound like my space.
You're not the one for me!🥀 Sea ya!
Soft Vibes
Soft music, I like relaxing vibes for my gatherings because then what everyone remembers is my stories!
I'm glad you've found your stage but I don't feel like watching a play at a party...🥱🥱
You're not the one for me!🥀 Sea ya!
Stay home
I like staying home and having fun indoors, I love a good board game!
Board games are not my style unfortunately..
Although I dominate at Fishopoly when I do play of course! 💪🥇
What music do you listen to when at home?
To sing to
I love loud music with a good beat, I adore singing to myself
It's great that we have the same music taste, but everything else doesn't sit right with me...🤔
You're not the one for me🥀, sea ya!
Lo-fi
Lo-fi music. I don't think music should be too loud...
We don't match at all, not even in what we listen to.
I don’t think we could have fun together, why did you😕?
You’re not the one for me!🥀 Sea ya!
No vocals
Classical only. I think every other kind of music is scary... Too many strangers singing
Scared of a singer? Timid as can be huh? I feel like if I got even a bit excited, I would definitely scare you off.. 🙊🙊
Not sure why you thought we would match…
You're not the one for me!🥀 Sea ya!
